name: Midway University
tuition_note: 2025-26 full-time traditional undergraduate tuition from midway.edu/financial-aid/tuition.html (via Wayback snapshot 2025-09-04; live page is behind a captcha wall): $13,750/semester x 2 = $27,500/yr. Private single-rate school (tuition only; standard fees add ~$450/yr: Technology $125 + Student Activity $100 per semester). Housing is room only, quoted per semester by hall/room type ranging $1,700-$2,800/semester; used representative Buster Hall Double $2,300/semester x 2 = $4,600/yr. Meal/board plans are billed separately ($1,670-$2,600/semester).
